changelog: Initial release: All 11 teams from the current season (including the team APXGP from F1: The Movie; we scrapped the idea of having our own team, called PLT), all 22 current drivers (and the APXGP drivers from F1: The Movie), updated driver icons, updated stats (including after the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix, and the stats will continue to get updated until the end of the 2026 F1 season), updated chassis models, updated team main sponsors (e.g. McLaren Vodafone -> McLaren Mastercard, AT&T Williams -> Atlassian Williams), updated engine suppliers, updated nationalities, and updated career stories.
